name: Cleveland Mahjong Collective
description: Cleveland-area group running American Mahjong 101 lessons, guided play and open play at restaurants and cafes (Cleveland, Avon, Medina). Own site: "We celebrate different types of mahjong from American Mahjong (the style with the yearly cards and the 'Charleston' swap) to the fast-paced, high-energy style of traditional Asian styles." Event pages: "Bring your 2026 NMJL card if you have one." Also runs some Chinese/Hong Kong style socials (not listed here).
address: Various venues in Cleveland, Avon and Medina, OH
schedule: Multiple sessions per week; tickets on Eventbrite (organizer page https://www.eventbrite.com/o/121189840863)
